SELECT trigger_record.*, (SELECT MIN(instance_record.id) FROM ifj_instance instance_record WHERE instance_record.trigger_id = trigger_record.id AND instance_record.parent_instance_id IS NULL) AS root_instance_id, CASE WHEN trigger_record.target_type = 'TASK' THEN (SELECT task_definition.name FROM ifj_task_definition task_definition WHERE task_definition.id = trigger_record.task_definition_id) WHEN trigger_record.target_type = 'JOB' THEN (SELECT job_definition.name FROM ifj_job_definition job_definition WHERE job_definition.id = trigger_record.definition_id) ELSE NULL END AS target_name FROM ifj_trigger trigger_record
AND trigger_record.target_type = #{targetType} AND trigger_record.target_id = #{targetId} AND trigger_record.trigger_type = #{triggerType} AND trigger_record.status = #{status} AND trigger_record.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND trigger_record.trigger_time >= #{from} AND trigger_record.trigger_time <= #{to}
AND ( (trigger_record.target_type = 'TASK' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifj_task_definition task_definition WHERE task_definition.id = trigger_record.task_definition_id AND LOWER(task_definition.name) LIKE LOWER(#{name}) )) OR (trigger_record.target_type = 'JOB' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifj_job_definition job_definition WHERE job_definition.id = trigger_record.definition_id AND LOWER(job_definition.name) LIKE LOWER(#{name}) )) )
ORDER BY trigger_record.trigger_time DESC, trigger_record.id DESC
